window.rationale: Trailing window length. About three years of monthly snapshots.

min_history.rationale: Fewer than 12 prior months is not a distribution. The line prints insufficient history.

z_high.rationale: About 2 sigma is the usual unusual-reading line.

percentile_high.rationale: Share sits at or above the 95th percentile of its own window.

percentile_low.rationale: Share sits at or below the 5th percentile of its own window.

watch_z.rationale: A milder band below the 2 sigma line.

flat_std_pp.rationale: A sample standard deviation under 0.05 percentage points is flat, so z is not computed.

money_gap_high_pp.rationale: Money growth exceeds hard-asset growth by 10 percentage points. Gold and bitcoin move more than money, so the default is wide.

money_gap_low_pp.rationale: Hard assets exceed money growth by 25 percentage points. The wider line reflects their higher volatility.

money_growth_min_pct.rationale: Money's own 12-month log growth is at least 4 percent, so the gap is not only a falling-money story.

signal2_points.rationale: Twelve monthly steps need the current point and the point 12 steps back.

equity_z.rationale: Equity share is elevated or depressed versus its own history, a milder line than signal 1.

real_yield_percentile_high.rationale: The 10Y real yield sits in the top quartile of the trailing 36 months of daily prints.

real_yield_percentile_low.rationale: The 10Y real yield sits in the bottom quartile of the trailing 36 months of daily prints.

yield_window_months.rationale: The real-yield percentile uses the trailing 36 months of daily Treasury data, which exists on day one.
